name: High Perch
summary: High Perch is an elevated bluff situated in the Arathi Highlands between Stromgarde Keep and the open plains. Its sweeping view of the surrounding hills makes it a natural vantage point in a region torn by territorial warfare.

sections.title: A Strategic Bluff
sections.body: Rising sharply above the central grassy plateau of the Arathi Highlands, High Perch overlooks the roads linking Stromgarde Keep to the wider plains. The steep slopes and natural elevation offer commanding views in every direction, making it an obvious tactical height for spotters and scouts seeking to track enemy movements across the grasslands.

sections.title: A Contested Territory
sections.body: The Arathi Highlands remain an active powder keg, divided between the human defenders of Stromgarde, the Horde based at Hammerfall, the Witherbark trolls, and roaming Syndicate brigands. Because High Perch dominates the surrounding landscape, controlling the height means denying your enemies an early warning against supply trains and troop maneuvers.

faq.answer: High Perch is located in the central Arathi Highlands, positioned on an elevated hill just east of the ruined stronghold of Stromgarde Keep.

Its height provides a commanding line of sight over the heart of the Arathi basin and the paths connecting Stromgarde to the wilderness, making it a critical vantage point for any military force operating in the area.

faq.q: What threats can be found around High Perch?
faq.answer: The nearby plains are frequented by predatory Plains Creepers, prowling beasts, and raiding parties from neighboring hostile factions such as the Syndicate and local trolls.

angles.text: For Alliance forces guarding Stromgarde Keep, High Perch guards the eastern approaches against incursions from the Horde and opportunistic bandits.
Warriors of the Horde operating out of Hammerfall recognize the high ground as a key observation post to survey enemy movements coming from Stromgarde.
